name: Carboneros (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and green with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carboneros (a tower, a lion, a saint's figure and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Carboneros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
